facts.value: filename feeds lbFile_80016760, which receives addresses of retained input pointer/size fields. Both input dimensions truncate to u16 before singleton sizing; header w/h assignments also convert to u16. The promoted u16 multiplication is signed-int arithmetic on the GameCube ABI and can overflow for large dimensions. Plane sizing uses product and product>>2; rendering instead halves each dimension separately, so odd dimensions do not establish a general matched plane-size contract. Decoder return values flow onward without validation. Only temporary context and work buffer are freed.
